title: Packaging using uberJar fails
body:
**Report Kind**: `Bug`

**Versions affected**: `0.7.0` and `master` (git hash: `98cf5fc0`)

When trying some of the quickstart examples with the `uberJar` flag configured for the  `shamrock-maven-plugin` like so:

```
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.jboss.shamrock</groupId>
        <artifactId>shamrock-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${shamrock.version}</version>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <goals>
              <goal>build</goal>
            </goals>
          </execution>
        </executions>
        <configuration>
          <uberJar>true</uberJar>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
```

the when trying to package the application using `mvn clean package`, the packaging fails with the following stack trace (trimmed to only provide the relevant info):
